lines.trans: Senior Yuqiao, I heard of your famous name back in college.
Getting to work together now makes me so happy.
Is there something you need?
When you are free, could we sit down together?
There are many things I would love to ask your advice about.
You enjoy drinking coffee, right?
There is a place near the office with good coffee; you can go try it.
Then what time do you get off work today?
My stomach is weak, so I cannot drink coffee.
Our boss's way of turning people down keeps getting sharper.
